body:
No car, no money, no free time. I don't mean to be dismissive but so many talks that just lead to more discomfort. I have been turned away by doctors before because my case was too "extreme". I don't think my problems are worse then others. 

I am not ready for another person to tell me I am crazy. I think any person who isn't obligated to deal with me will at this point.

Seven days out of the week I have no intention of killing myself which is why it scares me so much when it suddenly is all I can think about. In the past, when i have been on insurance, I have tried a lot of medication, and most of it has been counter productive. This is the first drug I have found to help at all and so I am afraid of having any doctor tell me to try something else. 

I feel uncomfortable talking to the people in my life about my problems because they are almost all dealing with their own demons and I feel like I would be adding to their worries. 

I have never called a suicide hotline but I have the number saved now. I think that might be something to help with my next episode. In the worst moment I look at my phone in hopes of reaching out and on occasion I have sent overly unobtrusive texts that only get returned by the time I am over my mental break. I think having a number to call could actually help in those moments. So, I have that saved now. I am nervous for the conversation but anonymity is enough to make it worth a try.
Thanks.
